title: Design System: Zhenghao YU Academic Homepage

display.purpose: The main semantic name; mobile sizing and the separate Daniel line are documented in DESIGN.md.

title.purpose: Base title hierarchy; project and publication variants permit natural wrapping.

detail-display.purpose: The complete scientific title, with narrower responsive sizes.

body.purpose: The final 15px prose cascade on main and detail pages at all breakpoints.

body-open.purpose: 15px hero introduction and project prose with 1.8 line height.

body-base.purpose: The desktop inherited 16px default; explicitly sized sustained passages remain 15px.

label.purpose: Compact metadata, statuses, resource links, and dates.

caption.purpose: Scientific media captions retain their full qualifications.

button.purpose: Primary/secondary actions and desktop section navigation.

graph-branch.purpose: Native topic buttons with stationary hit targets.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Button, navigation, menu, topic-note, reveal, and identity transitions.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Gentle drift of research-node text; hit targets remain stationary.

motion.name: interaction-transition
motion.purpose: Action feedback, navigation underline, menu entrance, and non-transient note changes.

motion.name: reading-entrance
motion.purpose: Once-only opacity .45 to 1 and translateY 12px to 0; default content remains visible.

motion.name: identity-reveal
motion.purpose: Initial name clip reveal only at the homepage top and only when enhancement is enabled.

motion.name: research-label-drift
motion.purpose: Visible desktop graph labels only; pauses for focus, hover, selection, global pause, reduced motion, hidden/offscreen state, and the phone layout.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Native evidence and CV actions; ink at rest, orange on hover.

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: The research exploration action inside the motion banner.
components.html: Explore research
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 20px;border:0;border-radius:999px;font:500 13px/1.75 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background-color 180ms ease}.ds-secondary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94513);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}}.ds-secondary{background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#242420)}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--surface-deep,#eae7e1)}.ds-secondary svg{width:17px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-secondary:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary svg{transition:none}}

components.name: Utility button
components.description: Circular theme control; the same bounds hold language and mobile-menu controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-utility" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark theme"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2m0 16v2M2 12h2m16 0h2M5 5l1.5 1.5m11 11L19 19M5 19l1.5-1.5m11-11L19 5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-utility{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:none;color:var(--ink,#242420);font:600 13px/1.75 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease,transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-utility:hover{background:var(--surface,#f5f4f1)}.ds-utility:active{transform:scale(.95)}.ds-utility svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-utility:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94513);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-utility{width:38px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-utility{transition:none}}

components.name: Top navigation
components.description: Section navigation with a thin current-location underline; the site script manages current location and the mobile menu.
components.html: AboutResearchWork
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;min-height:76px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#deded7);background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#242420)}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:23px 0;color:inherit;font:500 13px/1.75 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a::after{content:"";position:absolute;height:2px;background:var(--accent,#b94513);left:0;right:0;bottom:15px;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--accent,#b94513)}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a[aria-current="location"]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94513);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-nav{gap:17px}.ds-nav a{font-size:12px}}@media(max-width:850px){.ds-nav{min-height:68px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 26px}.ds-nav a{padding:12px 0;font-size:14px}.ds-nav a::after{bottom:8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a::after{transition:none}}

components.name: Research topic
components.description: A native research button; the live map supplies aria-controls, selection, focus previews, and arrow-key movement.
components.css: .ds-node{min-height:44px;padding:6px 10px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#242420);font:500 20px/1.3 var(--serif, Newsreader, "Songti SC", "Noto Serif CJK SC", Georgia, serif);white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-node:hover,.ds-node:focus-visible,.ds-node[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft,#faeee7);color:var(--accent,#b94513)}.ds-node:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94513);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-node{font-size:17px}}@media(max-width:850px){.ds-node{font-size:15px;padding-inline:5px}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-node{min-height:46px;padding:10px;font-size:17px;white-space:normal;background:var(--surface,#f5f4f1)}.ds-node:hover,.ds-node:focus-visible,.ds-node[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft,#faeee7)}}

components.name: Research note
components.description: A compact, polite status region below the map, with an ordinary research destination link.
components.html:
Research is connected.

Hover, tap, or tab to a topic to see how it connects to my work.

Explore the work
components.css: .ds-note{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:26px;min-height:108px;padding:20px 24px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#f5f4f1);color:var(--ink,#242420)}.ds-note strong{font:500 21px/1.4 var(--serif, Newsreader, "Songti SC", "Noto Serif CJK SC", Georgia, serif)}.ds-note p{margin:0;max-width:75ch;font:400 13px/1.7 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif);color:var(--muted,#62625b)}.ds-note a{flex:none;color:var(--accent,#b94513);font:400 12px/1.75 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif);text-underline-offset:.24em;text-decoration-thickness:1px}.ds-note a:hover{color:var(--accent,#b94513)}.ds-note a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94513);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-note{display:block;padding:18px;min-height:184px}.ds-note p{margin-top:5px;font-size:12px}.ds-note a{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px}}

components.name: Research reading row
components.description: A flat row separated by a thin rule, with a scholarly title and 15px description.
components.html:
Robot Design and Evaluation

Comparing robot designs and mount layouts against task requirements, then checking motion feasibility, collisions, and execution in simulation.
components.css: .ds-research-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:baseline;padding:28px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#deded7);color:var(--ink,#242420)}.ds-research-row h3{margin:0;font:500 24px/1.25 var(--serif, Newsreader, "Songti SC", "Noto Serif CJK SC", Georgia, serif);letter-spacing:-.01em;text-wrap:balance}.ds-research-row p{margin:0;color:var(--muted,#62625b);font:400 15px/1.75 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-research-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;padding:23px 0}.ds-research-row h3{font-size:23px}}

components.name: Method article
components.description: A detail-page method begins with its descriptive heading; redundant overline labels are absent.
components.html:
Nonlinear 2-DOF dynamics

MATLAB, Simulink, and Simscape Multibody models include configuration-dependent inertia, gravity, friction, payload, joint limits, and torque saturation.
components.css: .ds-method{padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#deded7);color:var(--ink,#242420)}.ds-method h3{margin:12px 0;font:500 26px/1.25 var(--serif, Newsreader, "Songti SC", "Noto Serif CJK SC", Georgia, serif);letter-spacing:-.01em;text-wrap:balance}.ds-method p{margin:0;font:400 15px/1.75 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif)}

components.name: Native scope disclosure
components.description: Optional scientific detail retains native disclosure behavior and sustained 15px project prose.
components.html:
Study scope

The 112-task success comparison comes from an earlier held-out validation. The later numerical study used five prespecified cases and four fixed controllers.
components.css: .ds-scope{margin-top:20px;color:var(--ink,#242420)}.ds-scope summary{cursor:pointer;width:fit-content;padding:8px 0;font:500 13px/1.75 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif)}.ds-scope summary:hover{color:var(--accent,#b94513)}.ds-scope p{margin:0;padding:8px 0 12px;color:var(--muted,#62625b);font:400 15px/1.8 var(--sans, Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif)}.ds-scope summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b94513);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}

narrative.overview:
A restrained, personal academic setting makes research, recorded experiments, and their context easy to inspect. The light world pairs white ground, charcoal text, and a warm orange accent; the dark world uses neutral charcoal surfaces with a lighter orange accent. Newsreader brings a scholarly voice to headings while Inter keeps prose and controls direct.

This records the approved, code-led implementation of the user-pinned [Zhouhu Tan reference](https://tanzhouhu.github.io/#research), as scoped in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) and [the surface brief](docs/reference-redesign.md). Thin separators and Inter are explicit reference commitments. A real portrait, a two-line identity, bounded particle lettering, and recorded simulation give the homepage its personal character; the detail page shares the same reading system. The source of truth is the final cascade in both stylesheets, including their closing readability and particle-layout rules.
keyCharacteristics: Scholarly serif headings and sustained, bilingual sans-serif prose.
Flat reading surfaces, thin separators, and restrained orange emphasis.
A real portrait, two-line name, particle lettering, and labeled simulation preview.
Native controls, visible keyboard focus, and usable static fallbacks.
Research evidence retains its captions, scope, source links, and downloads.

rules.name: The Reference Continuity Rule
rules.body: Keep the user-pinned thin separators and Inter body type; they are part of this approved visual world.

rules.name: The Reading Size Rule
rules.body: Keep sustained prose at the final 15px size on phones and desktops; do not recover superseded smaller declarations as design tokens.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve the flat surfaces and structural rules used by the shipped pages.

dos: Do retain the user-pinned thin separators, Inter body text, and Newsreader headings.
Do preserve the two-line name, real portrait, and full wrapping scholarly titles.
Do use the final 15px sustained prose size in both languages and at every breakpoint.
Do keep the particle CTA and hint in separate normal-flow rows with a 10px gap.
Do preserve native buttons, links, video controls, visible focus, and static reading fallbacks.
Do retain evidence captions, simulation qualifications, original PDF URLs, and the distinction between validation protocols.
donts: Don't reintroduce superseded 13px/14px sustained-prose defaults from earlier CSS rules.
Don't add redundant method labels above the existing descriptive headings.
Don't hide scholarly content until an animation completes or require motion to navigate.
Don't represent recorded simulation as physical-robot execution.
